text:
marta_oncall: I think incidentbot stopped paging our rotation for infra.high-latency. Getting alerts in #incidents but no PD pages. Seeing 'filtered by match-chain' in the bot log. anyone else?
jen_sre: yep i saw that too, just now. logs show filter_chain applied on webhook path.
alex_devex: @marta_oncall can you paste the exact log line?
marta_oncall: here —
```
automation: matched rule 'squelch-maintenance' -> filter_chain(reason=regex_whitelist_miss) -> drop
webhook_id=inc-12345 pid=9873
```
jen_sre: ugh, that regex whitelist was added last week for noisy non-prod traffic. looks like it matched an encoded service-tag on prod PD payloads.
sam_platform: i'm on it, checking deploys — nothing in infra router today. might be a ruleset push from automation service.
ops_shift_lead: immediate mitigation: can someone trigger manual fallback paging for active incidents? we can't rely on automation right now.
alex_devex: running manual page to current rotation with pagerduty-bot: `/pagerduty trigger service=infra.high-latency severity=critical note="manual fallback: automation filter matched"`
pagerduty-bot: triggered incident INC755432, notified rotation: infra-oncall (call + sms).
marta_oncall: confirmed phone ring. thanks. i'll take ownership of incident and start triage.
jen_sre: thanks. i've started a short rollback of the filter chain on staging, will promote to canary in 5 if green.
sam_platform: FYI I found the bad rule: it was anchored to `^/integrations/.*` but PD webhook now POSTs to `/integrations/pd/encode%2F...` url-encoded segments caused match to fail and fall through to `regex_whitelist_miss` which currently drops by default.
alex_devex: can we change default to safe-fail -> route to fallback instead of drop? that would avoid silent misses.
ops_shift_lead: agreed — open a short-lived mitigation: change policy to `drop -> fallback` for unknown-filter outcomes. who can make the config change?
jen_sre: i can push a hotfix to automation config now, will switch unknown outcome to `route:fallback`. rolling now.
automation-bot: config update applied by jen_sre at 2026-03-20T09:12:34Z — unknown_filter_outcome -> fallback-route.
jen_sre: applying to canary first. monitoring PD deliveries.
marta_oncall: manual pages still active, but i'm seeing duplicate alerts in the console — probably because the bot retried before filter change. i'm muting noise for the duration.
sam_platform: canary looks good, fallback routing is receiving the webhooks and paging target. promoting to 3 more nodes.
alex_devex: noted for postmortem: need test vectors for url-encoded webhook paths + a safe default policy. i'll file an action item.
ops_shift_lead: customer impact? any missed external pages?
marta_oncall: short window (~6m) where automated pages were dropped. we manually paged and mitigation was immediate. no customer-facing pager escalations recorded, internal SLI shows a small latency spike since re-triage.
jen_sre: creating follow-up ticket: AUT-4342 "incidentbot: safe-fail routing and url-encoding rule tests" and tagging eng-sre + devex.
alex_devex: thumbs up. after-action: add canary test that simulates encoded PD webhook path and asserts delivery to PD and fallback route.
ops_shift_lead: good. i'm marking this thread resolved for live ops once jen confirms rollout across all nodes.
jen_sre: rollout to all nodes completed at 2026-03-20T09:21:58Z. monitoring for 15m.
marta_oncall: resolved for now. will include timeline and impact in the incident report. :thumbsup:
